home.dropTitle: Drop an app, shortcut or link here
home.dropBody: On this computer you can drop a browser link, a store link, or a shortcut file. LifeHub only reads what you drop.
onb.lead: Everything you need, in one place.
onb.f4: Private: your data stays on this device
onb.aboutLead: Emergency numbers follow the region. Money uses your currency. Language is separate. You can change each one later.
onb.name: Your name
onb.sample: Start with sample data so I can explore
onb.signIn: How do you want to sign in?
onb.signInLead: Pick what's easiest for you. You can change it later.
onb.passkeyLead: Use your face, fingerprint or screen lock to open LifeHub.
onb.passkeySim: Passkeys not available here: use simulated biometric
onb.ssoLead: Demo: no real account is contacted. A live build would use {method}.
auth.passkeyDesc: Face, fingerprint or device screen lock
search.title: Search
search.hint: Search contacts, events, bills, apps, chats, medical info and emergency numbers.
emerg.title: Emergency
emerg.iceEmpty: No emergency contacts yet. Open a contact and turn on "Emergency contact".
emerg.foot: In a life-threatening emergency always call {num} directly. Numbers verified for {place}; check local numbers when travelling.
emerg.noGeo: Location not available on this device
emerg.fail: Couldn't get location ({why}). Tell the operator your address or nearest landmark.
med.title: Medical
med.foot: Medical details are stored only on this device. Keep them up to date; first responders may use your Medical ID.
med.hidden: Medical ID is hidden on the lock screen. Unlock to view.
med.apptEmpty: No appointments yet. Add one and it shows on your calendar.
bank.title: Banking
bank.demo: No real bank is connected. Balances, transfers and payments are simulated on this device.
bank.plannerSub: Categories, goals and what you have left this month
bank.schedEmpty: Add rent, a loan or a transfer and it appears on your calendar. This does not move any money.
bank.foot: Scheduled payments are a reminder on your calendar, not a real debit. Bank linking in a live version would use an accredited open-banking provider.
cal.title: Calendar
cal.emptyAhead: Nothing coming up. Add an event or set up your work schedule.
cal.foot: Bills, budget bills, appointments, medication times, scheduled payments, birthdays, social events and dated apps appear here automatically.
budget.title: Budget
budget.goalsEmpty: No goals yet. A holiday fund or an emergency buffer both fit here.
budget.setLimit: Tap to set a monthly limit
budget.foot: Your budget stays on this device. Recurring bills also show on the calendar. Alerts start at {pct} of a limit.
docs.title: Documents
docs.empty: Nothing here yet. Add a PDF, photo, spreadsheet or text file from this device.
docs.foot: Files stay in this browser's database. A safety check runs on this device when you add one. It is not an antivirus scan of your phone or computer.
docs.missing: This file is not in the on-device database any more.
add.title: Add New
add.syncLead: Tick apps you might already use and add them in one step. LifeHub cannot see what is installed on this device.
add.drop: Drop an app, shortcut or link here
add.dropBody: A browser link, a Play Store or App Store link, or a shortcut (.lnk, .url, .desktop, .webloc). LifeHub only reads what you drop.
set.title: Settings
set.languageNote: Language changes the words. Region and currency change numbers, dates and emergency numbers. They stay separate.
set.planSubPrem: No ads · location · budget tools · themes
set.bannerNote: Reorder or hide banners to keep Home tidy. Emergency always stays visible.
set.wifiSub: Use mobile data only when Wi‑Fi isn't available
set.safetyNote: Safety check looks at files and links you add to LifeHub. It does not scan this device, and it does not send them anywhere. It is not an antivirus.
set.strictSub: A caution is blocked too. You cannot choose Add anyway.
set.noChecks: No checks yet. One runs when you add a file or save a link.
set.safetyFoot: Checks stay on this device. A reputation list can be added later. None is used now.
set.exportSub: Download everything as a JSON file
set.version: LifeHub prototype v{v} · {net} · Installed copies update themselves. Dates use Australia/Hobart time.
safety.title: Safety check
safety.lead: This looks at what you are adding to LifeHub. It does not scan your device, and nothing is uploaded.
safety.strictOn: Strict mode is on, so a caution cannot be added.
safety.ok: Nothing in this check stood out.
safety.doubleExt: The name has two extensions ({prev} and {ext}). The last one is the type that would open.
safety.program: This is a program or script (.{ext}). LifeHub will not store it.
safety.hiddenProgram: The contents are a program, but the name does not say so.
safety.magic: The contents ({magic}) do not match the .{ext} name.
safety.macroType: This Office file is a macro-enabled type (.{ext}).
safety.bomb: This archive is unusually large when opened, which can be a zip bomb.
safety.zipProgram: The archive contains a program or script ({name}).
safety.ole: This older Office file looks like it contains macros.
safety.pdf: This PDF contains {token}, which can run or open something when the file is opened.
safety.tooBig: This file is over 80 MB, which is too large to keep in the browser.
safety.badLink: This does not look like a usable link.
safety.badScheme: This kind of link ({scheme}) can run or open a local file. LifeHub will not save it.
safety.http: This link is not encrypted (http, not https).
safety.ip: The address is a raw IP address, not a normal site name.
safety.puny: The address uses punycode, which can imitate another name.
safety.tld: The ending .{tld} is often used in trick links.
safety.short: This is a shortened link, so the real destination is hidden.
safety.user: The link hides the real site behind a username.
safety.secret: The link includes something that looks like a password or token ({keys}).
safety.lookalike: This address looks like {hit}, but it is not the usual site.
safety.partial: Only the first 8 MB of this large file were checked.
plan.title: Your plan
plan.priceLater: Shown until a store price is available. Nothing is charged now.
plan.demo: Demo billing. No money is charged in this prototype.
plan.checkoutLead: Demo checkout. No card is charged and no real subscription is created.
loc.title: Location
loc.off: Sharing is off. Tick each person, choose how long, then start. There is no option to share with everyone.
loc.demo: Other people's pins are simulated on this device, not their real location.
loc.mapsNote: Opens the Google Maps app on a phone. There is no paid maps key. Coordinates go to Google only when you tap a button.
toast.currency: Currency updated. Amounts were not converted.
toast.overlap: Schedule overlap. Open Calendar to sort it out.

ad.premiumBody: Sharper photos, live refresh · price from the store

set.privacyCard: What you enter stays in this browser on this device. LifeHub has no server and no analytics. The Home ad is a sample, not a tracking network. Banking, chat, social feeds and other people's map pins are demos.
